concerns.text: Phase 7 (T045–T050) implements 'Cross-Cultural Stylometric Validation' and 'open-ended reader reflections' which have no corresponding User Story, Functional Requirement, or Success Criterion in spec.md or plan.md. The spec defines ReaderResponse with only empathy/moral scores, not free-text reflections. These tasks represent unapproved scope creep with no traceable requirement.

Task T010 (Validation test) specifies a sample size of '10 stories' and a correlation threshold of '≥ 0.85'. However, spec.md SC-001 explicitly requires a 'manually annotated gold-standard subset of 50 stories' to verify the pipeline. The task fails to cover the volume requirement of the success criterion, risking non-compliance with SC-001.

Task T030 mandates fetching a 'validated proxy dataset' and explicitly forbids implementing a survey interface. This contradicts spec.md User Story 4, which requires collecting data from 'human participants (or a validated proxy simulation)' and includes an acceptance scenario where a 'participant completes the reading and the survey'. The task removes the 'human participant' option entirely, failing to cover the full scope of US-4.

Task T050 requires updating research.md to cite an 'arXiv-preprint on story generation' to address a reviewer's suggestion. No such reviewer suggestion or citation requirement exists in spec.md, plan.md, or the provided inputs. This task references a non-existent requirement/element.
